## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue with
`Refs #number`; use `Closes #number` only when this change completes it.

## Validation

Describe the relevant checks and their results. State any deferred device checks.
For documentation-only changes, link checks are sufficient.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a clear scope and follows the contributing/design guidance.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and issue checklists reflect the resulting behavior.
- [ ] No private credentials or personal data are included.
